Privacy Smart Glass for Homes and Businesses

Smart Films International (“SFI”) is a developer and manufacturer of Glass Innovative Products mainly used in Architecture.

OUR PRODUCTS

SMART FILMS INTERNATIONAL

Smart Films International (SFI) is a leading developer and manufacturer of PDLC Smart Film and Smart Glass Film solutions for advanced privacy control. We offer a wide range of products, including smart glass, adhesive smart film, laminated smart films, insulated smart glass units (IGUs), and reverse smart films (PNLC).

​

For over 25 years, our smart film and privacy solutions have been trusted across various applications, including commercial, residential, healthcare, industrial, hospitality, automotive, and artistic spaces.

Choosing Smart Films International means choosing experience and dependable quality.

BECOMES A PARTNER

Architects & Designers

Encourages long-term partnerships with interior designers, architects, project managers and contractors. We provide comprehensive guidance and ongoing support throughout the process of installing smart glass or adhesive smart film on existing glass surfaces.

Becomes a Film Installer

SFI builds lasting partnerships with film installers. We offer in-depth guidance and continuous support throughout the smart film installation process on existing windows.

Qualified As a Glass Laminator

Encourages long-term partnerships with interior designers, architects, project managers and contractors. We provide comprehensive guidance and ongoing support throughout the process of installing smart glass or adhesive smart film on existing glass surfaces.
